title: James M NDE 3305
content: My Uncle Carl (who had just returned from the Korean War) was living with us and offered to take us children swimming at Percy Quinn State Park, Pike County, Mississippi. I was just learning to swim and we were at a beach on the west side of the lake. My brother Mike (two years younger than me) could not swim and he stepped in a hole under the water. He started yelling for help and I was close by and did not realize there was a hole. I went to him and as I approached, I stepped in the hole. Mike had panicked and as I went down, he climbed on top of me. I tried to fight him off but he was pushing me down and I could not get free. At first, I saw the bubbles float before my eyes that must have been wide open. Shortly, I realized that I was going to die. With that thought and acceptance, everything changed: all the pain of coughing water went away, and I was floating up to a light that seemed to be pulling me; then I seemed to turn and I could see the beach where we had been swimming. There were people there and one was sitting down and I realized it was me; I was pulled back toward my body but it was like I was but a wisp of smoke drawn to my physical body. As I approached my body, I turned to slide into the body and the pain came back. Uncle Carl had pulled us both from the water and I don't think he did anything to revive us other than a slap on the back to expel water. He told us to not tell our parents for fear that they would be angry with him. I never talked about the experience with brother Mike and we tried to forget the incident. I did not think of or talk about the experience and did not know of anything like near death experiences until there was a book published on the subject. And I did not experience a tunnel or other people (deceased) so wasn't sure if I had a true NDE.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Pain of coughing water went away; felt floating and being pulled toward a light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning/near-drowning while swimming in a lake (stepped into a hole underwater; brother climbed on him).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Near-drowning with acceptance of death; pain ceased; floating upward toward a pulling light; then turned to see the beach and his body; pulled back into body with pain returning.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing the beach/body occurred after starting to float toward the light; no tunnel, no beings, no life review, no boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reported no tunnel and no encounters with deceased or other beings; described returning as 'a wisp of smoke' drawn back to the body.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was pulled back toward my body but it was like I was but a wisp of smoke drawn to my physical body.”
